candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500 across all correlated requests, so the checkout 502s are a downstream propagation of order-service server errors.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-service internal cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only the 500 surface is established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s correlate with order-service 500s on /v1/orders in traces and logs; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The bounded cause is order-service HTTP 500 propagating to checkout. Order-internal root cause remains unobserved.
